notes: Case sensitivity: exact comparison vs lower() vs full casefold() (which expands ß to ss).
Which characters count: every character, everything except whitespace, Unicode alphanumerics only, or ASCII [a-z0-9] only.
Empty / content-free input: vacuously True, False (nothing to compare), or ValueError.
Unicode combining sequences: compare raw code points vs NFC-normalize first (composed vs decomposed accented letters).
Non-ASCII letters: Unicode-aware isalnum keeps them as significant, ASCII regex silently discards them.
